newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks seen correcting with Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks seen correcting with Wall Street.

text.p: Singapore shares were seen likely to draw inspiration from the overnight correction on Wall Street on Tuesday but dealers said sentiment remained cautious.
They said further gains could be seen on foreign tranches of blue chips amid continued pressure on the local tranches after companies dismissed merging the dual listings for now.
"But it will take some time before foreign investors can be encouraged to buy again. Recent merging news has introduced another element of uncertainty in the market," said a dealer.
On Monday, The Straits Times Industrials Index fell 34.95 points to 1,918.85 while Wall Street rebounded 108.70 points to 7,803.36.
